policy: Only official packages (Anthropic, the Model Context Protocol project, Node.js built-ins, OS tools, GitHub's own actions) or packages the owner approved with why, value and what-if. Packages a listed package depends on are covered by its approval and appear in the SBOM. Every shipped licence must be on the allowed list.

@modelcontextprotocol/sdk.owner: Model Context Protocol project (official TypeScript SDK)
@modelcontextprotocol/sdk.why: Implements the MCP protocol and the stdio transport the server speaks.
@modelcontextprotocol/sdk.value: Protocol compliance with Claude Code, Claude Desktop and Codex without writing JSON-RPC by hand.
@modelcontextprotocol/sdk.whatIf: Without it the protocol layer would be ours to write, test and keep current with each MCP revision.
@modelcontextprotocol/sdk.approvedBy: owner (nnthanh101), in the Claude Code session

zod.owner: zod maintainers; required peer dependency of @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
zod.why: Tool input and output schemas; the SDK validates tool calls with it.
zod.value: Every tool argument is validated before the tool runs.
zod.whatIf: The SDK cannot register typed tools without a zod version it supports.
zod.approvedBy: owner (nnthanh101), in the Claude Code session

typescript.why: Type-checks and compiles src/ to dist/.
typescript.value: Type errors fail the build instead of reaching users.
typescript.whatIf: Plain JavaScript with no type gate.
typescript.approvedBy: owner (nnthanh101), in the Claude Code session

@types/node.why: Type definitions for Node.js 24 built-ins, used only at build time.
@types/node.value: The compiler checks every node: API call.
@types/node.approvedBy: owner (nnthanh101), in the Claude Code session

@anthropic-ai/mcpb@2.1.2.why: Packs the Claude Desktop bundle; run through npx at release time only, never installed in this project.
@anthropic-ai/mcpb@2.1.2.advisory: npm audit reports 6 advisories (3 high) in its own dependencies (its private zod copy, prompt libraries); none ships in the bundle.
@anthropic-ai/mcpb@2.1.2.approvedBy: owner (nnthanh101), in the Claude Code session
@anthropic-ai/mcpb@2.1.2.acceptedRisk: Owner accepted the 3 high advisories in the tool's own dependencies: release-time only, run through npx in CI, nothing from it ships in the bundle.
